# Xeeplians
The little grey men which scourned the minds and assaulted the bodies of people throughout history and, much more recently, assault the jukebox at the bar with tunes.
They do not need to breathe and do not take damage from the pressure of space. They are unable to speak Tau-Ceti Basic without the assistance of a translator or translation implant and can communicate with one another via a telepathic link known as the [color=#ff00d4]Glorpmind[/color].
## Xeeplian Naming Conventions
Xeeplian names are often singular words taken from the Xeeplian language. However, some Xeeplians earn honorifics depending on their status in the Abduction Counsel. Some take on names which are mistranslations or misinterpretations of items of interest in the cultures of other sentient creatures, notable from the pop culture of the early 2000s of humanity. Try to avoid direct or unchanged references to media. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Zlarp - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Dr. Geegle - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Emess Paint - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Koiby - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Spunch Bop - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Paul - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Dr. House - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Skibidi Toilet
## Lore
The first defection of Xeeplians from the dominance presented by the Abduction Counsel was actually caused from the first interactions of Xeeplians with media from the early 2000s and late 1900s of the human species. This fascination with their popular culture lead to a mass flunking out of the colleges of the Abduction Counsel, and led to a mass emesis from their homeworld. Many of these defectors have applied for positions in companies such as NanoTrasen but paperwork sorting is still ongoing.
